2125251334156775722.en_summary: $ANT is now trading at a fully diluted market cap of $1.42T with $250B of cash on the balance sheet. So their EV is under $1.2T. While $ANT secured the cash and can sleep calm, if it stays at this valuation or lower, OpenAI will have problems if it needs to raise funds in the near future. OpenAI recently did the $1.25T round, with worse business economics and growth than $ANT. If they try to do a round or IPO in the near future, they would have to do it at a lower valuation than the previous one. If we enter the RSI era where compute is the only driver of new model training progress, $ANT is fine with $250B in cash, and $GOOGL and $META also have big enough pockets, while OpenAI might be at risk of not having enough compute to compete.
2125251334156775722.zh_summary: $ANT現以完全稀釋市值1.42萬億美元交易，資產負債表上有2500億美元現金。因此其EV低於1.2萬億。雖然$ANT已確保現金可安心，但如果估值維持或更低，OpenAI若近期需籌資將有問題。OpenAI最近做了1.25萬億輪，業務經濟和增長比$ANT差。若近期嘗試輪次或IPO，必須低於前一輪估值。若進入RSI時代，計算是新模型訓練進展唯一驅動，$ANT有2500億現金沒問題，$GOOGL和$META口袋也夠大，而OpenAI可能有風險沒有足夠計算力競爭。
